name: process
doc:
process: running child processes (Go's os/exec), asynchronously.

  var r = await process.Run("git", ["status", "--short"])?
  println(r.ExitCode, r.Stdout)

  var p = process.Start("sort", [], process.Options{Stdin: process.Pipe, Stdout: process.Pipe})?
  _ = await p.Stdin.Write(strings.Bytes("b\na\n"))?
  p.Stdin.Close()
  var out = await p.Stdout.ReadAll()?
  var code = await p.Wait()?

The pipes implement io.AsyncReader / AsyncWriter (waits go through
the scheduler's poller; no worker thread blocks). Cancelling the task
that waits (task.WithTimeout, Options.Timeout) kills the child.
Runtime: runtime/src/std_process.c.

items.name: Inherit
items.doc: Inherit makes the child use the parent's stream (Options.Stdin/Stdout/Stderr).
items.summary: Inherit makes the child use the parent's stream (Options.Stdin/Stdout/Stderr).

items.name: Null
items.doc: Null connects the child's stream to the null device.
items.summary: Null connects the child's stream to the null device.

items.name: Pipe
items.doc: Pipe connects the child's stream to a pipe of the Process.
items.summary: Pipe connects the child's stream to a pipe of the Process.

items.name: LookPath
items.doc:
The path of an executable named file: file itself if it contains a
"/", else the first match in $PATH.
items.summary: The path of an executable named file: file itself if it contains a "/", else the first match in $PATH.

items.name: Output
items.signature: async func Output(cmd string, args []string) string!
items.doc: The stdout of cmd; an error (with stderr) if it exits non-zero.
items.summary: The stdout of cmd; an error (with stderr) if it exits non-zero.

items.name: Run
items.signature: async func Run(cmd string, args []string) Result!
items.doc: Runs cmd to completion, capturing stdout and stderr (stdin: /dev/null).
items.summary: Runs cmd to completion, capturing stdout and stderr (stdin: /dev/null).

items.name: RunWith
items.signature: async func RunWith(cmd string, args []string, opts Options) Result!
items.doc:
Run with options (Dir, Env, ClearEnv, Timeout); the streams are fixed:
stdin /dev/null, stdout and stderr captured.
items.summary: Run with options (Dir, Env, ClearEnv, Timeout); the streams are fixed: stdin /dev/null, stdout and stderr captured.

items.name: Start
items.signature: func Start(cmd string, args []string, opts Options) Process!
items.doc: Starts cmd (looked up in PATH unless it contains "/") with args.
items.summary: Starts cmd (looked up in PATH unless it contains "/") with args.

items.name: Options

members.name: ClearEnv
members.doc: Start from an empty environment instead of inheriting this one.
members.summary: Start from an empty environment instead of inheriting this one.

members.name: Timeout
members.doc: Kill the child if it runs longer (zero: no limit).
members.summary: Kill the child if it runs longer (zero: no limit).

members.name: Stdin
members.doc: Pipes for the streams started with Pipe (otherwise closed/empty).
members.summary: Pipes for the streams started with Pipe (otherwise closed/empty).

members.name: Wait
members.doc:
Waits for the child to exit and returns its exit code (128 + n if
it was killed by signal n, like a shell). Idempotent.
members.summary: Waits for the child to exit and returns its exit code (128 + n if it was killed by signal n, like a shell).

items.name: ReadPipe
items.doc: The read end of a child's stdout/stderr.
items.summary: The read end of a child's stdout/stderr.

members.name: Read
members.doc:
Up to n bytes as they arrive; empty at the end of the stream
(io.AsyncReader).
members.summary: Up to n bytes as they arrive; empty at the end of the stream (io.AsyncReader).

members.name: ReadAll
members.doc: Everything until the end of the stream.
members.summary: Everything until the end of the stream.

members.name: Success
members.doc: True if the exit code is 0.
members.summary: True if the exit code is 0.

items.name: WritePipe
items.doc: The write end of a child's stdin.
items.summary: The write end of a child's stdin.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Closes stdin (the child sees end of input).
members.summary: Closes stdin (the child sees end of input).
